# Producer callback nominal result

Owned Java 8 helper: a public static method binds its sole Object formal through a complete covariant List and a contravariant binary callback, returning an independent fixed String. The existing owned append target is a closed auxiliary. The returned String comes from opaque state, so input identity, callback output and actual result are independently observable.

The frozen observer covers four call routes, repeated calls, partial snapshots, callback and append order, sticky initialization failures, null/empty inputs and late checked casts. Source/SDK-input profiles compare all original metadata and compile every emitted Java file. Five same-code Signature controls and eight wrong implementations must fail.
